item.tib: khro bo dbang chen gyi gshed gzhung
item.coloph: de ltar dbang chen khro bo'i gshed chog 'di/ rig 'dzin rnams kyi thugs bcud/ phyi rabs thugs rjes 'dzin pa'i don mdzad/ spa dro'i(gro'i)gter ma/ lung zla 'od nas/ gzhon nu'i bston (nus bton) pa'o/ rim par brgyud nas smra ston jo 'bum la/ blo gros bdud 'dul gyis zhus so/ rim gyis brgyud nas bdag la brgyud pa'o//
